units.source_text: “带有练习走路的意思，我试着到府中市去了。

en.t: Thinking of it as practice in walking, I tried going to Fuchu City.

units.source_text: 在那儿看了赛马，太痛快了。

en.t: I watched the horse races there, and it was wonderfully exhilarating.

units.source_text: 我心头涌上了一股‘能下棋了’的难以想象的力量。

en.t: An unimaginable strength welled up in my heart, the feeling that I could play go again.

units.source_text: 回到家中，却已累得精疲力竭，这是体质还很虚弱的缘故吧。

en.t: When I got home, however, I was completely exhausted, probably because my body was still very weak.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我还是去看了两次赛马，下棋似乎不会有什么障碍了。

en.t: Even so, I went to watch the races twice, and there seemed to be no real obstacle to playing go.

units.source_text: 于是，今天决定在十八日左右继续对弈。”

en.t: So today we decided to continue the match around the eighteenth.
